gmConfirmsDamage.name: GM applies damage
gmConfirmsDamage.hint: A hit does not remove HP right away: a chat card appears and the GM applies or rejects the damage with a button. Unchecked, damage applies at once and the GM can undo it from the card.

card.title: Hit: {amount} damage
card.splash: Splash: neighbouring compartments take {amount} damage each.

specialHint.splash: Compartments sharing a side with the target take half the damage — to their own HP only, not to the ship's hull.
specialHint.charge: The first press charges the gun and uses its shot this round; it can fire from the next round.
specialHint.volley: Each damage die is a separate shot: its own target, its own hit check and one damage die.

undo.name: Undo in the builder
undo.hint: Undoes the last placement, move or removal in the open ship builder.

effects.title: Active effects
effects.hint: A ship counts a compartment's effects while it is intact and “Effect enabled” is on. Keys and modes are in the “Active effects” help page. Placed compartments get edits via “Update on ships”.
